periods.name: Thanksgiving Day
periods.short_forecast: Showers And Thunderstorms then Heavy Rain
periods.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms before 10am, then rain. Some of the storms could produce heavy rain. Cloudy, with a high near 68. Southeast wind 16 to 33 mph, with gusts as high as 49 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between 2 and 3 inches possible.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.short_forecast: Slight Chance Light Rain then Mostly Cloudy
periods.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of rain before 7pm. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 47. Southwest wind 16 to 24 mph, with gusts as high as 35 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

periods.name: Friday
periods.detailed_forecast: Mostly cloudy, with a high near 55. Southwest wind around 23 mph, with gusts as high as 35 mph.

periods.name: Friday Night
periods.detailed_forecast: Partly cloudy, with a low around 40. West wind 14 to 18 mph, with gusts as high as 30 mph.
